title: 19 精满20 差距21 马爷
slug: 我有装备栏460上次那一位
content_zh:
;;
戌时。
齐知玄下班，回到黑暗无灯的宿舍，关起门来。
【你获得一副十全大补汤的药效加持，气血+10%，肌肉+2.5%，壮骨+0.3%，需要持续装备15小时。】
装备栏正在持续发挥效用。
齐知玄缓口气，闭上眼。
脑海中回忆《赤火搬血法》种种细节。
招式须得圆融贯通。
呼吸节奏须得合拍。
齐知玄缓慢地演练，揣摩每个动作，每次呼吸。
渐渐地，他练得越来越快。
呼吸与招式，像是榫和卯，一点点靠近彼此，最后严丝合缝，完美契合在一起。
终于！
齐知玄第一次做到了正确施展赤火搬血法，从头到尾没有一处错漏。
【赤火搬血法第一层：入门】
“汩汩！”
这个瞬间，他心跳如鼓，体内的气血疯狂加速，血液犹如沸腾，变得燥热。
皮肤快速发红发烫，晕洒出微微血光，驱散了身周的黑暗。
“入门了！”
齐知玄站在原地，喜不自禁。

这一刻，他突然感觉到自己的五官一下变得通透起来，耳边传来远处的喧嚣，鼻子闻到了各种气味，就连眼睛也能够在黑暗里看得更加清楚了。
这就是激发气血的好处。
赤火搬血法第一层，重在积累气血、激发气血。
而积累足够多的气血，是激发气血的前提。
齐知玄之所以能够如此顺利的激发气血，说明他体内的气血是比较多的，底子不薄。
“好，再接再厉！”
齐知玄又练了几遍，巩固这份成果。
这时，他注意到装备栏闪烁了下。
【你获得一副十全大补汤的药效加持，气血+10%，肌肉+2.5%，壮骨+0.3%，需要持续装备8小时。】
“咦，8小时？！”
齐知玄眨了眨眼，他记得很清楚，十全大补汤需要持续装备的时间应该是15小时。
但在他激发气血之后，装备时间一下缩短到了8小时。
“也是，我现在气血高涨，身体机能大大增强，消化和吸收速度自然变快……”
“好好好！”
齐知玄转念一想，心情不由得万分愉悦。
一夜很快过去。
第二天早上，赤火武馆。
房间里，六十八位新学徒全部到齐，无人缺席或迟到。
宋伦没有现身，依然是由白云霄带领一众新学徒修炼。
“还没有记住口诀的，跟我诵读，其他人先自行修炼，我待会儿过去指点你们。”

白云霄按部就班开始教学。
一时间。
有二十九位学徒转身走开，分散在院子各处。
content_en:
;;
Xu Shi.
Qi Zhixuan got off work, returned to the dark dormitory without lights, and closed the door.
[You gain the medicinal effects of a pair of Shiquan Dabu Decoction, qi and blood +10%, muscles +2.5%, bone strengthening +0.3%, and need to be continuously equipped for 15 hours. 】
The equipment slot continues to work.
Qi Zhixuan breathed slowly and closed his eyes.
He recalled all the details of "Red Fire Blood Removal Technique" in his mind.
The moves must be coordinated and coordinated.
The breathing rhythm must be in time.
Qi Zhixuan practiced slowly, studying every movement and every breath.
Gradually, he practiced faster and faster.
Breathing and movements, like tenon and tenon, get closer to each other little by little, and finally fit together perfectly.
finally!
For the first time, Qi Zhixuan successfully performed the Red Fire Blood Removal Technique without any mistakes from beginning to end.
[The first level of red fire blood removal method: Getting started]
"Gurgling!"
At this moment, his heart beat like a drum, the energy and blood in his body accelerated wildly, and his blood seemed to be boiling and became hot.
The skin quickly turned red and hot, and a faint blood glow dissipated the darkness around him.
"Getting started!"
Qi Zhixuan stood there, unable to control himself with joy.
At this moment, he suddenly felt that his facial features suddenly became clearer, distant noises could be heard in his ears, various smells could be smelled in his nose, and even his eyes could see more clearly in the darkness.
This is the benefit of stimulating Qi and blood.
The first level of the Red Fire Blood Movement Technique focuses on accumulating and stimulating Qi and blood.
Accumulating enough qi and blood is the prerequisite for stimulating qi and blood.
The reason why Qi Zhixuan can stimulate Qi and blood so smoothly shows that he has a relatively large amount of Qi and blood in his body, and his foundation is not weak.
"Okay, keep up the good work!"
Qi Zhixuan practiced a few more times to consolidate this achievement.
At this time, he noticed that the equipment column flashed.
[You gain the medicinal effects of a pair of Shiquan Dabu Decoction, qi and blood +10%, muscles +2.5%, bone strengthening +0.3%, and need to be equipped continuously for 8 hours. 】
"Eh, 8 hours?!"
Qi Zhixuan blinked. He remembered clearly that the time required to equip Shiquan Dabu Decoction should be 15 hours.
But after he stimulated the energy and blood, the equipment time was shortened to 8 hours.
"Yes, my energy and blood are now high, my body functions have been greatly enhanced, and my digestion and absorption speed has naturally become faster..."
"Okay, okay!"
Qi Zhixuan thought about it and couldn't help but feel extremely happy.
The night passed quickly.
The next morning, Chihuo Martial Arts School.
In the room, all sixty-eight new apprentices were present, and no one was absent or late.
Song Lun did not show up, and Bai Yunxiao still led the new apprentices to practice.
"If you haven't memorized the formula yet, recite it to me. The others will practice on their own first. I'll go over and give you guidance later."
Bai Yunxiao started teaching step by step.
For a while.
Twenty-nine apprentices turned away and scattered throughout the courtyard.
